![Threat Monitor screensaver](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kuydigital/threat_monitor/main/docs/screens.png)

**Cleaner war headlines.** The WAR screen no longer shows games, films, sport or wildlife stories that happen to use words like "invasion" (for example a video game called *Cosmic Invasion*, or an invasion of mussels). A plain "invasion" now counts like "war", and only military phrases such as "ground invasion" or "invaded" count as the most serious. Pitch invasions, war-veteran features and US "Department of War" contract notices are also left out. Created and maintained by Oliver Kuy.

Install the same way as before: on Windows, unzip and double-click **install.bat**; on a Mac, double-click **Threat Monitor.saver**. On a Raspberry Pi, run the one-line installer again to update. If you're updating on a Mac, log out and back in afterwards so macOS loads the new version.
